name: Ramesh Kumar
portalProblem: Unfiled supplier bill #AP/2026/045 (Asian Paints) for ₹4,500 tax credit. On the official portal, Ramesh would have claimed full ₹4,500 credit, resulting in automated notice under Section 16(2)(aa).
ourSolution: System automatically detects missing GSTR-1, blocks ₹4,500 credit safely, and generates a 1-tap WhatsApp/SMS reminder to Asian Paints.
easeAndImpact: Prevents ₹10,000 penalty notice & 18% interest charge. Processed in 1 click.

name: Sunita Sharma
portalProblem: Tax amount mismatch: Physical bill shows ₹18,000 tax, but Jaquar filed only ₹12,000 on GSTR-2B. Portal threw cryptic mismatch error.
ourSolution: Rule 102 caps claim at portal limit (₹12,000) for safe filing and generates a 1-click amendment request for the remaining ₹6,000.
easeAndImpact: Saved ₹6,000 over-claim penalty notice while allowing immediate return filing.

name: Gurpreet Singh
portalProblem: Supplier uploaded UltraTech invoice #UT/2026/112 late on August 18th (after the 11th monthly cutoff date).
ourSolution: Rule 105 flags late upload and defers ₹9,800 ITC to next month automatically without human error.
easeAndImpact: Zero portal rejection. Credit is 100% preserved for next month's return.

name: Kavita Reddy
portalProblem: Accidental duplicate entry of Polycab invoice #POLY/2026/178 in accounting software.
ourSolution: Rule 103 detects duplicate GSTIN + invoice combination and rejects duplicate entry.
easeAndImpact: Avoided double ITC claim rejection, audit investigation, and interest penalty.

name: Vikram Patel
portalProblem: Purchased goods from a local wholesaler whose GSTIN was cancelled suo-moto by tax authorities.
ourSolution: Rule 104 verifies supplier registration status on live portal API, completely blocking ₹2,700 ineligible credit.
easeAndImpact: Protected from illicit credit utilization audit under Section 16(2)(aa).

name: Meenakshi Sundaram
portalProblem: Cryptic portal error codes in English created extreme confusion. Speaks only Tamil.
ourSolution: Native Tamil script UI + Web Speech API 1-Tap Tamil Audio Narration explaining exact fix out loud.
easeAndImpact: 100% comprehension without paying external CA fees.

name: Aniket Deshmukh
portalProblem: Unsure about correct HSN code and GST tax rate for industrial paints and emulsions.
ourSolution: Built-in HSN Lookup Service (GET /api/services/hsn-lookup) instantly provides HSN 3208 and 18% rate.

name: Priya Nair
portalProblem: Confused about net cash tax liability vs eligible input tax credit before filing deadline.
ourSolution: Real-time Net Tax Payable Calculation Engine (Sales Tax ₹42,500 - Eligible ITC ₹18,200 = Net Cash ₹24,300) + Printable HTML Receipt Generator.

name: Rajesh Varma
portalProblem: Struggled to import raw Tally/Excel sales invoices into portal-compatible format.
ourSolution: Custom Raw Invoice Array Parser (POST /api/invoices/parse-raw) ingests raw CSV/Excel rows and computes CGST, SGST, IGST automatically.
easeAndImpact: Filing time reduced from 4 hours to 30 seconds.

name: Amina Begum
portalProblem: CA legal jargon (e.g. 'Section 17(5) Blocked Credit', 'Rule 36(4)') caused fear and anxiety.
ourSolution: Shopkeeper Mode vs CA Technical Mode Switcher ('Dukan Mode'). Converts legal jargon into simple everyday advice.
